'Draw a card then discard a random card. If a card with 6 or more {p} is discarded this way, banish a card from a graveyard.' Shadow Brute Action - Attack. BloodDebt is in printed_keywords, so it fires from the card DB - not authored here.

NO TRIGGER WORDING: unlike Bare Fangs ('When this attacks, draw then discard...'), this text has no 'when', so it is one flat PLAY resolution, not TRIGGERED ON_ATTACK. Release note 2 ('no priority during resolution; you cannot play anything after drawing but before discarding') is exactly one flat effect sequence: DRAW -> DISCARD_RANDOM -> test -> banish.

DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM TRIAGE (1): it listed DISCARDED_CARD_POWER_GTE, but that condition reads .power off the DISPATCHING EVENT (condition_types.py:1046-1052); inside a PLAY resolution that event carries no discarded card, so the gate would be false in every state while looking implemented - the exact defect .review findings record for wrecking_ball_red / ram_raider_yellow / breakneck_battery_red / predatory_assault_blue. DISCARD_RANDOM stores the card actually discarded under ref 'discarded' (effect_types.py:5027-5029) precisely so 'THIS WAY' is expressible; REF_POWER_GTE(ref 'discarded', amount 6) reads ref+amount and any list entry satisfies it (condition_types.py:2090-2118). Same fix as the sibling bare_fangs_* drafts, whose printed clause is identical. Empty hand edge: nothing discarded -> ref never set -> get_ref None -> condition false -> no banish, while draw/discard still resolve.

DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM TRIAGE (2): plain BANISH fixes whose graveyard at compile time (player SELF or OPPONENT), but release note 4 says 'any player's graveyard'. CHOOSE (effect_types.py:5107-5136, verified: reads amount + options, runs the chosen option's effects) offers exactly the two BANISHes; there is no decline option, so banishing stays mandatory per release note 3, and the just-discarded card is a legal pick since it reached the graveyard before the prompt.

KNOWN IMPRECISION: CHOOSE cannot make an option unavailable, so with exactly one non-empty graveyard the player can pick the empty side and dodge a banish the release notes call mandatory (both empty forces a pointless prompt but no-ops correctly, since BANISH breaks on an empty pool). Expressing 'choose a non-empty graveyard' would need a new generic type; not attempted.

Shape copied from sibling drafts deadwood_rumbler_blue/yellow in this directory; every handler claim re-verified directly against effect_types.py / condition_types.py this session.
